{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - "main"
    tags:
      - "v*"
  pull_request:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version: "stable"
          cache: true
      - run: go mod tidy
      - run: go test -v -failfast -race -coverpkg=./... -covermode=atomic -coverprofile=coverage.txt ./... -timeout=2m
      - uses: codecov/codecov-action@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          file: ./coverage.txt",
  "rationale": "The workflow already caches Go modules via actions/setup-go with cache: true, so adding a separate actions/cache for Go modules (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) is contraindicated because an equivalent cache already exists. The supported, applicable optimization is P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT: the job has no job-level timeout, while CI history shows representative successful runs completing in roughly 1-2 minutes. Adding timeout-minutes: 10 bounds runaway job consumption with ample headroom over the existing go test -timeout=2m and historical durations, preserving every step, coverage collection, permission, and secret usage without adding network access or privileged actions. Measured experiment evidence for this pattern reports elapsed savings of 9.79% and 26.83% with all runs still succeeding.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--112e2b2e7fbe04b8", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}
